summary: Build Doc 20 (Tool Intelligence /api/hi/tools) and Build Doc 13 (Project-First Marketplace /api/hi/market) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed (/app/backend/tests/test_diyhomie_docs_20_13.py, ~18s) — Doc 20: GET /pack/{iid} returns tools[] + safety_gear[] SEPARATELY with owned/likely_owned/required flags + status in {ready, ready_with_alternatives, missing_required, unsafe_tool_gap}; POST /pack/{iid}/check persists and moves status off unsafe_tool_gap when a missing safety item is checked; POST /ask returns verdict in {yes, yes_with_care, no, verify_first} + logs gr_decisions; POST /procure-advice returns recommendation in {buy, rent, borrow} + reasoning + disclaimer; POST /items/{id}/capabilities on a Tool inventory item returns capability_tags (>=1) + power_source in the allowed set; admin GET /api/hi/admin/tools/signals returns tools_total+tools_with_capabilities+tool_packs and is gated (403 for demo user); other user's tool pack returns 404. Doc 13: GET /issues/{iid}/entry PROJECT-GATED (gated:true + message) for fresh issue without BOM; with BOM returns requirements[] with resolved flags + essentials_unresolved + project_ready + disclosure; POST /items/{bom_item_id}/options returns 1-3 options each with compatibility in {confirmed_fit, verify_fit, alternative} + compatibility_basis + needs_verification + 4 retailer_links; second call returns cached:true; POST /items/{id}/select rent -> BOM item status will_rent (verified via /api/hi/readiness); POST /cart/{entry_id}/status obtained -> BOM item becomes have_it; GET /cart/export returns 'SHOPPING LIST' text grouped by fulfillment section; POST /outbound with consent=true returns attributed:true+url+disclosure, PUT /preferences attribution_consent:false -> attributed:false (restored to true); PUT /preferences budget_pref:invalid returns 400; admin POST /flag pause + resume works (200); admin GET /signals gated (403 for demo); other user's cart entry returns 404. Frontend (390x844 mobile, demo_home@diyhomie.com): auth via 'I already have an account' -> Log in tab -> LOG IN button worked; repair workspace (/home-intel/repair/72625ba1) shows both rw-toolpack + rw-readiness banners; Tool Pack screen (/toolpack/{id}) renders tp-status card ('Tool-ready' state visible), 'Safety gear (checked separately — tools don't protect you)' section rendered SEPARATELY from 'Today's tools' list, 4x tp-check-* checkboxes toggle correctly, 1x tp-adv-btn-* Buy/rent? button visible on missing 'Camera or smartphone', tp-ask-input + tp-ask-send present; Readiness screen (/readiness/{id}) shows 100% ready summary with rd-market banner ('Get what you need — compatible options, honest labels, buy/borrow/rent'), rd-status-* count 3 (rd-generate not shown since BOM exists — expected); Marketplace screen (/market/{id}) renders 'Every essential is resolved — you're ready to work' + disclosure text + mk-consent (checked), 3x mk-req-* cards (Ladder+Flashlight resolved w/ 'obtained' pill, Camera or smartphone optional w/ Options button), 1x mk-options-* button, mk-export ('Export shopping list (2)') visible; Command center (/home-intel/command) loads with Urgent+Active+Maint.+Follow-ups tiles (regression pass); Inventory Tool detail (idx 2 TEST_UI_Hammer) renders invd-caps 'What can this tool do?' button. All flows working, no red screens, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: tool_intelligence_engine.py cleanly separates tools vs safety_gear via SAFETY_KEYWORDS whitelist; status decision tree is deterministic (missing_safety -> unsafe_tool_gap first, then missing_required, then alt_only, then ready); baseline 'Safety glasses' auto-injected when plan exists; capabilities generation stores capability_tags + safety_notes + power_source on hi_inventory_items with strict enum validation on power_source; tool_ask uses inventory context + battery_platforms + capability_tags for grounded answers and logs gr_decisions.

marketplace_engine.py enforces project-gated entry (no BOM -> gated:true + message); options cached in mk_options and re-served with cached:true; not_recommended options filtered out; select() writes bom item status via deterministic map (buy->will_buy, rent->will_rent, borrow->will_borrow, use_owned->have_it, professional_supply->skipped) and syncs rd_boms so readiness stays truthful; cart obtained/purchased flips BOM to have_it; outbound honors mk_prefs.attribution_consent (attributed:false skips mk_attribution insert); admin pause categories checked BEFORE cache serve so paused categories always 423.
Cross-user isolation: both engines use {id, user_id: user['id']} filters so other user's issue/cart entries return 404.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (rw-toolpack + rw-readiness banners, tool pack tp-status + separate safety gear section + tp-check-* + tp-adv-btn-* + tp-ask-input/send, readiness rd-market banner + rd-status-*, marketplace mk-consent + mk-req-* + mk-options-* + mk-export, command center regression, inventory invd-caps on Tool item)
